free_tier.stated: 10 GiB of storage, 1 million state-change operations and 10 million state-read operations per month, free forever, for every user in the US; EU storage has no free tier

egress.terms: The first-party rate card states 'Egress fees None' and the product page markets zero egress fees; the published terms require a funds-on-deposit balance applied to charges when incurred.

tooling: the standard S3 API, so rclone s3 and any S3 SDK apply
chaining: 10 GB per account with no card needed and no egress charge is 50 accounts for 500 GB, which is absurd for the volume but worth noting for the egress model alone. The paid rate at USD 6.14/TB/month with genuinely free egress is a solid second to the cheapest paid option

limits.value: 10 GB is the free tier total, which is the cap in practice
unverified: the first-party docs state public buckets are available only in US, APAC and CA regions, but do not state the registration requirement

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the first-party sign-up page shows only organisation structured data, and the published terms require a funds-on-deposit balance applied to charges; the exact registration fields are behind a sign-up

reliability_note: The rate card states no egress fee. The first 10 GiB is free only in US storage; EU storage has no free tier. An account with negative available credit cannot create a bucket or upload, and data is purged if credit stays negative for 30 days.
